summary: __stdcall bitmask mutation of the global dword_8B8EE0 (0x008B8EE0). When a2 is non-zero, the bits of a1 are OR-ed into the global (set); otherwise the inverted bits of a1 are AND-ed in (clear). In both branches the return value is the new logical state: a1 | global on set, ~a1 on clear. Referenced by VidMan_Init (004FA320).

local_names.a1: bitmask whose bits are set into or cleared from the global
local_names.a2: branch selector: non-zero = set, zero = clear

operations.description: Branch on a2: non-zero selects the set path, zero selects the clear path.
Set path: dword_8B8EE0 |= a1; result = a1 | dword_8B8EE0.
Return result: new combined bitmask state from the executed branch.
Invoked by VidMan_Init (004FA320), placing this in video-manager initialization bitmask configuration.

unresolved: Semantic meaning of each bit in dword_8B8EE0 is unknown; only the set/clear transform is evident.
The set branch stores the new value into the global but returns the pre-stored computation, so the returned value differs subtly between branches; intent is unconfirmed.
